title: From DNA to RNA
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: The RNA is 5′–A U G C U U–3′. It is complementary and antiparallel to the DNA template; RNA uses U where DNA uses T.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: The RNA is 5′–A U G C U U–3′. It is complementary and antiparallel to the DNA template; RNA uses U where DNA uses T.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: An RNA polymerase reads the DNA template 3′–T A C G A A–5′. Which RNA strand does it build 5′ to 3′? The RNA is 5′–A U G C U U–3′. It is complementary and antiparallel to the DNA template; RNA uses U where DNA uses T.
Recall: What RNA base normally pairs with A in the DNA template? RNA uses uracil to pair with A in the DNA template.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.
